reviews.text: Love them! Very nice staff and they all really care for your furbabies. Very clean and tidy.
Always so kind and attentive, and they have all the equipment to care for your pet, and the best prices in the area! We are grateful for their clinic, and have been clients since 2013.
They always provide excellent service for my puppies
Conscientious staff that help through the good and hard times. Knowledgeable and kind.
Love the staff. This is the best place if you are looking for animal care

Dr. Gilbert is super sweet and down to earth. I always appreciate her loving on my girl!
Prices are about average id say

This is the first vet clinic ive been to in my entire adult life where the vet and techs all showed true care and concern, and I could tell that they genuinely loved animals and were there because they were passionate about helping my pets.

In today's world,  where a huge majority of veterinary facilities are being bought up by corporations or private equity groups,  to monopolize pet health care prices and make them as unaffordable as human health care is, this PRIVATELY OWNED clinic was honestly SHOCKINGLY affordable!

They've got a bit of a waiting list to get your pet in for non emergencies, but that's because I'm obviously not the only person who sees their genuine love for our pets.

While this clinic is (deservingly) not the best hidden gem, it definitely outshines all the rest in our area!

What a great group of people. Empathetic, professional, accommodating, and thorough. Little things like a card in the mail after helping us say goodbye to two of our dogs meant so much. Ongoing care for our other two dogs has the exact same experience. I cannot recommend them highly enough.
Staff is friendly and knowledgeable. Doctors are compassionate and very helpful.
The best they just take care of your babies without trying to price gouge you.   Love them.
Been going here for years.  Dr. GIilbert and Dr Jones are awesome.   Its a drive for me, but they are honest and affordable.
Always friendly and professional
I love these folks. They always take good care of my cat, Lucky Bubba.

Love this place! Very well organized and very reasonable.  Most of all they are  all so caring and attentive to every  animal that comes in.  My dog loves to go there and doesn't want to leave. They took care of my dog until the very end. The entire office came out including, Dr. Gilbert, to console me when I lost my last dog. Now I am bringing my new puppy to them, I wouldn't go anywhere else. Highly recommend!

If I could leave a zero-star review I would. Do not take your pets here for an emergency. My kitten died this morning and this clinic only made matters worse in the situation. A kitten I found recently was having a medical emergency and was non-responsive when I woke up. I chose this establishment first since it was closest to me. I called and someone answered and said they were open, a lady. Upon arriving around 7 a.m, the receptionist denied us any service. Not even literally to look at the kitten with her eyes. Her reasoning was that there was no doctor yet so she couldn't do anything about it and nonchalantly apologized... In my opinion, she could at least have taken a quick moment to help a dying kitten when it is her profession to not just sit behind a desk at a veterinarians clinic. I did not have time to wait for a doctor, ma'am. Shame on you if you read this. Morally, you could have given me some life-saving advice when every second matters!
There was no one else in the clinic by the way, not customers nor co-workers. Her attitude was cold to the situation and I was baffled at her response. I immediately left and rushed him across the Huffman bridge to Atascocita Animal Hospital and they were much, much more friendly and immediately willing to take a second to look at him. Without a doctor in house mind you! When lives matter there is no excuse. Period. I am very ashamed. I will make sure to let every animal owner I know to not take their loved pets here.
Great people place and they took great care of my pet.

Just so you know, they hit you with a surprise,you must have Bordetella vaccine when you drop off to spay.
Extra $20 for you to pay
Great experience!!! Quick and informative about the health of my dogs. Everyone was friendly and helpful. Will definitely recommend them to friends and family.
Great vet and fair prices.
It's very professional and friendly vet clinic. I do Highly recommend them them.
Staff and Dr's are always friendly, helpful and caring.
Been going there for over 15 years.

Have been taking my many cats and dogs here since 2022. They are busy so try to anticipate and make an appointment. Vets and staff are friendly and knowledgeable. Prices are fair.  Most important is that they make you feel that they care.
I started using this veterinarian clinic years ago after I was not happy with the one I was using. Great Vet and awesome employees.

This place is wonderful been coming here since before they built this new place. We've had great experiences with the doctors and staff. They are a busy location but really care about your pets. They are going to be starting new hours soon.
Caring staff
They are always so accommodating, very respectful and so pleasant to talk to
